procedures.purpose: Resolve the owning project and load its instructions before substantive action.
steps: Read AI_ENTRYPOINT.json.
Run the repository entry router for every affected path.
Load every resolved project entrypoint, nested AGENTS.md, registry, validator, and stopping rule.
Honor the emitted disposition.

procedures.purpose: Bind work to immutable repository identities.
steps: Resolve each supplied ref with git rev-parse <ref>^{commit}.
Record the exact 40-character commit SHA.
Resolve and record parent and merge-base identities when lineage matters.
Reject abbreviated, missing, or moving refs as final evidence.

procedures.purpose: Execute against committed state rather than conversation or private working state.
steps: Fetch the exact required commits.
Create a detached checkout or worktree at the governing head.
Verify git status --porcelain is empty.
Execute only the repository-declared command.
Write outputs outside the repository or to an ignored path.

procedures.purpose: Provide a clean execution backend when a local room cannot clone or run the repository.
steps: Use the procedure-specific workflow declared by the project entrypoint.
Checkout the exact governing head with full history.
Pass the exact target commit as an explicit workflow input.
Run the same repository gate or validator used by the local backend.
Upload the command-emitted receipt and fingerprint even when the gate fails.
Bind the result to workflow run, job, artifact, governing head, and target commit identities.

procedures.purpose: Continuously preserve the AI entry point's ability to start an allowlisted native GitHub Actions workflow even when the connected GitHub tool does not expose workflow_dispatch directly.
steps: Prefer the connected GitHub workflow_dispatch write primitive whenever it is available.
If direct dispatch is unavailable, read .github/ai-router/workflow-dispatch-capability.v1.json and select only an allowlisted capabilityId.
Resolve exact current main and create a fresh ephemeral branch named ai-dispatch-request-<requestId> from that exact commit. Never reset or reuse an older request branch.

Create one request commit on that branch containing only .github/ai-entry/workflow-dispatch-request.json with schema AI_ENTRY_WORKFLOW_DISPATCH_REQUEST_v1, a unique requestId, and the allowlisted capabilityId.
Open a same-repository execution-only pull request from the ephemeral request branch to main with an AI Dispatch: title. The transport PR must never be merged.

The ordinary pull_request bridge runs only for same-repository ai-dispatch-request-* branches, checks out authoritative main, validates that the request commit parent equals current main, resolves protected inputs such as CURRENT_MAIN_SHA, calls GitHub's native workflow_dispatch API, and recovers the resulting workflow run ID.
Read .github/ai-entry/receipts/<requestId>.json from ai-dispatch-receipts and require NATIVE_WORKFLOW_DISPATCH_ACCEPTED_AND_RUN_RESOLVED before treating the target workflow as started.
Use dispatchedRunId from the receipt for all subsequent jobs, steps, logs, artifacts, deployment, and verification inspection.
On success, the bridge closes the transport PR and deletes the ephemeral request branch. The durable receipt remains on ai-dispatch-receipts.
Failed transport PRs remain unmerged and diagnosable; they never become product or release commits.
Never substitute a dummy product commit, release-branch nudge, issue-comment carrier, generic command workflow, destructive branch reset, or manual UI action when this capability is available.

procedures.purpose: Determine exact divergence without assuming branch state.
steps: Resolve exact base and head commits.
Compute merge base.
List every changed path and blob identity.
Record ahead and behind counts.
Treat unrelated main advancement separately from candidate lineage.

procedures.purpose: Recover executable evidence from GitHub Actions.
steps: Resolve workflow run and job identities.
Inspect step conclusions and logs.
List artifacts by exact run.
Download the named artifact.
Verify artifact digest and contained receipt identities.

procedures.purpose: Distinguish repository identity from file names and summaries.
steps: Resolve Git blob SHA for committed text identity.
Compute SHA-256 for transported artifact bytes.
Record byte count and member manifest for archives.
Reject name-only or URL-only identity claims.

procedures.purpose: Make execution durable and independently discoverable.
steps: Use the procedure-declared receipt schema.
Bind exact governing and target commits, commands, measurements, artifacts, and disposition.
Commit only after validation when repository publication is authorized.
Preserve workflow artifact identity when repository publication is not authorized.
Record exact starting head and changed paths.
Declare the rollback operation before promotion.
Execute rollback in an isolated branch or worktree.
Verify protected blobs and accepted baseline identities are restored exactly.

procedures.purpose: Load and apply whole-estate narrative and display continuity laws before applicable page, frontier, product, room, world, campaign, navigation, transition, responsive, or shared visual-system construction.
steps: Read .github/ai-router/display-continuity-constitution-v1/display-constitution.v1.json and .github/ai-router/display-continuity-constitution-v1/README.md.
Read control-plane/whole-estate/narrative-continuity-development-map-v1/map.v1.json and the governing narrative spine when narrative relation is material.

Resolve the route display contract: local identity, narrative relation, orientation relation, display role, runtime ceiling, persistent objects, transition meaning, progressive disclosure, mobile composition, reduced-motion equivalence, return contract, claim boundary, local visual identity, and continuity hook.
Treat the runtime class as a ceiling, not a requirement.
Preserve Compass global orientation, room-local identity, explicit return, semantic meaning under reduced motion, and claim boundaries.
If the task is not visual or experiential, do not invent display work or widen the admitted scope merely because this global context exists.
Honor all project-specific entrypoints, nested AGENTS.md files, scientific and evidence boundaries, and runtime authorities after loading this context.
